purpose: nondecreasing fault-trace adapter with exact equal-time event audit
time_policy: backwards rejected; exact equal timestamps retained; positive max gap supplied by CLI (campaign 1e-6)

equal_group_policy.retained: left/group/right all raw fields with zero-based source row indices
equal_group_policy.threshold_predicate: inject/f2/fault high iff >=2.5 V; q/en/arm/permit health iff >2.5 V; gate-off iff <=0.20 V; channel retention iff >0.10 A
equal_group_policy.thresholds: fault_inject/f2ctl/fault inclusive >=2.5 V; q/en/arm/permit strict >2.5 V; abs gate inclusive <=0.20 V; abs channel strict >0.10 A

acceptance: none; transport/evidence only, no protection or hardware qualification
